title: Zachary Wentz Calls Out Fans Who've Found His Private Address - NewsBreak
text:
By Thomas Lowson ,
27 minutes ago
AEW’s Zachary Wentz has issued a warning to fans who have found his personal address and have sent him mail in a breach of his privacy.
On Twitter, Wentz made it clear that this isn’t okay, calling it an invasion of privacy, safety, boundaries, and respect.
READ MORE: Brian Knobbs Hospitalized Once Again, Could Lose His Foot
READ MORE: Linda McMahon’s Visit To Elementary School Cancelled After Outrage From Parents
Wentz acknowledged that while he appreciates that fans are excited and may want something signed, this is not the right way to do things.
Dear fans, as @HellsFavoritePK and I have asked many of times, please do not send fan mail to our personal address. It is an invasion of privacy, safety, boundaries, and respect. If you would like something signed, please bring it to a show or signing near you. All unsolicited mail will be discarded. I understand you’re excited and want things signed, but this is not the way to go about it. Thank you for your understanding.
Wentz’s fiancée, Priscilla Kelly (fka WWE’s Gigi Dolin), has also made it clear that those who reach out to the couple via their personal address are acting inappropriately.
